title: SoloraMC
description: SoloraMC is a Server that provides it's players with a creative and exciting LifeSteal & Survival experience
body:
SoloraMC Network is a server containing exciting gamemodes like Survival & LifeSteal. With regular updates, friendly community you will never get bored.
Survival offers exciting progression thru quests, custom mobs, custom terrain, and much more custom stuff to keep you busy while building and enjoying the Survival Server!

LifeSteal offers exciting competition in PvP, Teams, legendary weapon events that are limited to only one! Try to win one and be the strongest on the server!
Custom Enchants, LifeSteal Rules and much more will keep you busy while playing!

Welcome to SoloraMC!
